column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2006's real-database StaleSetShape test for MySQL guards on CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL being unset and skips ONCE (env-var check fires before the -short check is reached), unlike a registeredBackends test which costs two here. Measured by name, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run 'TestStaleSetShapeMySQLAgainstARealDatabase|TestStaleSetShapeMSSQLAgainstARealDatabase' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two, one each. Added because mocks cannot see the MSSQL RLS session-context bug this PR fixes -- a real-database test is the only thing that would have caught it, and it needs its skip declared rather than falling to __UNATTRIBUTED__.

dialect-gated: cleat#2006's real-database StaleSetShape test for SQL Server, the dialect the whole PR is about. Guards on CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL being unset and skips ONCE, same shape as the MySQL line above. Same measurement command. Before this PR's fix, this exact test (run with CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set) failed with Running: 0, err: nil -- the beginTxWithContext fix in engine/mssql_operations.go is what this test exists to hold in place.
